block.gtceu.mega_distillation_tower.tool: Up to 64 recipe copies per paid parallel, without charging extra EU/t for the bonus copies.
Accepts one parallel hatch in the base. Each group of up to 64 copies costs one parallel's EU/t; partial groups round up.
Twice the recipe duration. Uses standard distillation tower overclocking.
1 to 11 middle layers; total height 3 to 13 blocks including the base and roof.
Fluids are assigned from bottom to top. Each middle layer and the roof require an output hatch at the marked position.
